dataFlows.transformKql:
source
| where type == "indicator" and pattern_type == "stix" and isnotempty(pattern)
| extend TimeGenerated = now()
| extend Pattern = tostring(pattern)
| extend PatternVersion = tostring(pattern_version)
| extend SourceStixId = tostring(id)
| extend idHex = substring(tostring(hash_sha256(strcat(SourceStixId, '|', Pattern))), 0, 32)
| extend Id = strcat('indicator--', substring(idHex,0,8), '-', substring(idHex,8,4), '-', substring(idHex,12,4), '-', substring(idHex,16,4), '-', substring(idHex,20,12))
| extend ValidFromRaw = tostring(valid_from)
| extend ConfidenceRaw = toint(confidence)
| extend CreatedRaw = tostring(created)
| extend ModifiedRaw = tostring(modified)
| extend ParsedKey = extract(@"^\[(.*?) = '", 1, Pattern)
| extend ParsedValueRaw = extract(@"= '(.*)'\]$", 1, Pattern)
| extend UnescapeStep1 = replace(@"\\\\", "@@BKSL@@", ParsedValueRaw)
| extend UnescapeStep2 = replace(@"\\'", "'", UnescapeStep1)
| extend ParsedValue = replace("@@BKSL@@", @"\\", UnescapeStep2)
| extend ObservableKey = iff(isempty(ParsedKey), "stix:pattern", ParsedKey)
| extend ObservableValue = iff(isempty(ParsedKey), Pattern, ParsedValue)
| extend SourceSystem = 'PolySwarm'
| extend LastUpdateMethod = 'PolySwarm curated feed'
| extend Confidence = ConfidenceRaw
| extend IsActive = true
| extend IsDeleted = false
| extend Revoked = false
| extend ValidFrom = todatetime(ValidFromRaw)
| extend ValidUntil = datetime_add('day', 90, todatetime(ValidFromRaw))
| extend Created = todatetime(CreatedRaw)
| extend Modified = todatetime(ModifiedRaw)
| extend AdditionalFields = pack('source_stix_id', SourceStixId, 'pattern_version', PatternVersion, 'observable_parse_note', iff(isempty(ParsedKey), 'pattern did not match the expected [key = value] STIX comparison shape; Pattern and Data are still authoritative, only ObservableKey and ObservableValue are best effort', ''))
| extend Data = pack('type', 'indicator', 'spec_version', '2.1', 'id', Id, 'created', CreatedRaw, 'modified', ModifiedRaw, 'pattern', Pattern, 'pattern_type', 'stix', 'pattern_version', PatternVersion, 'valid_from', ValidFromRaw, 'confidence', Confidence, 'indicator_types', pack_array('malicious-activity'))
| project TimeGenerated, Id, ObservableKey, ObservableValue, Pattern, SourceSystem, Confidence, IsActive, IsDeleted, Revoked, ValidFrom, ValidUntil, Created, Modified, LastUpdateMethod, AdditionalFields, Data
